verses.tl: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu lima tuharrimu maa ahalla Allaahu laka tabtaghee mardaata azwaajika Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Qad farada Allaahu lakum tahillata aymaanikum Wallaahu mawlaakum wa huwal-aleemul-hakeem

Wa idh asarran-nabiyyu ilaa ba'di azwaajihi hadeethan falammaa nabba'at bihi wa azharahu Allaahu alayhi arrafa ba'dahu wa a'rada an ba'din falammaa nabba'ahaa bihi qaalat man anba'aka haadhaa qaala nabba'aniyal-aleemul-khabeer
In tatoobaa ilaa Allaahi faqad saghat quloobukumaa wa in tazaaharaa alayhi fa-innallaaha huwa mawlaahu wa jibreelu wa saalihul-mu'mineena wal-malaa'ikatu ba'da dhaalika zaheer
Asaa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwaajan khayran minkunna muslimaatin mu'minaatin qaanitaatin taa'ibaatin aabidaatin saa'ihaatin thayyibaatin wa abkaaraa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo qoo anfusakum wa ahleekum naaran waqooduhan-naasu wal-hijaaratu alayhaa malaa'ikatun ghilaazun shidaadun laa ya'soona Allaaha maa amarahum wa yaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta'tadhirul-yawma innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo tooboo ilaa Allaahi tawbatan nasoohan asaa rabbukum an yukaffira ankum sayyi'aatikum wa yudkhilakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yawma laa yukhzee Allaahun-nabiyya wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu nooruhum yas'aa bayna aydeehim wa bi-aymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa innaka alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu jaahidil-kuffaara wal-munaafiqeena waghluz alayhim wa ma'waahum jahannamu wa bi'sal-maseer

Daraba Allaahu mathalan lilladheena kafaroo iimra'ata noohin waimra'ata lootin kaanataa tahta abdayni min ibaadinaa saalihayni fakhaanataahumaa falam yughniyaa anhumaa mina Allaahi shay'an wa qeelad-khulan-naara ma'ad-daakhileen
Wa daraba Allaahu mathalan lilladheena aamanoo iimra'ata fir'awna idh qaalat rabbi ibni lee indaka baytan fil-jannati wa najjinee min fir'awna wa amalihi wa najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa maryama ibnata imraanal-latee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehi min roohinaa wa saddaqat bikalimaati rabbihaa wa kutubihi wa kaanat minal-qaaniteen
